lines.t: Who you are — be-hind your doors — that’s your name.
When the lights — go down, still the truth re-mains.
No disguise — can hide that flame — He feels your aim, He sees your ways.
Every move — shows the mark — that you claim.
No two faces — in the light — and the shade,
Real vibes rule — and truth never fades.
Your heart speaks loud-er than your words ever can.
By your steps, the world — knows just who is — The I am.
Every moment tells — a story in hand,
We’re re-vealed — by the heart, oh, re-vealed by the heart.
A man’s action paints — his soul so clear.
His mouth defines — the vi-sion we hear.
Let rhythm of truth — e-cho near, stand sincere.
No walls needed now — just be pure, be dear.
Don’t hide your rhythm — be- hind pride’s tide.
Let your spirit move — and truth be your guide.
Your heart speaks loud-er than your words ever can.
By your steps, the world — knows just who is — The I am.
Every moment tells — a story in hand,
We’re re-vealed — by the heart, oh, re-vealed by the heart.
It’s the un-seen day — that shows who we are.
The home within — shines bright-er than afar.
Live the same — in the light and the dark.
Let honesty — spark your star.
By your steps, the world — knows just who is — The I am.
Ev’ry rhythm tells — the truth where love stands.
We’re re-vealed — by the heart, yeah, re-vealed by the heart.
Heart… heart… truth in the rhythm…
Heart… heart… show who we are…
